rules.name: cs-19-verify-deployment
rules.sql: SELECT p.problem FROM ( SELECT 'fn_statement_position_summaries_v2 is not v8 (no leg rounding list)' AS problem WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_statement_position_summaries_v2' AND position('client_statement_leg_rounding_table' in prosrc) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT 'fn_statement_position_summaries_v2 still has the global v7 rule (v_section = OTC_SWAPS AS v_leg_rounded)' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_statement_position_summaries_v2' AND position('v_section = ''OTC_SWAPS'' AS v_leg_rounded' in prosrc) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT 'fn_refresh_client_statement_positions has no case-insensitive spot match' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_refresh_client_statement_positions' AND position('2026-11-12: case-insensitive' in prosrc) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT 'fn_refresh_client_statement_positions still drops zero-lot trades (not v5)' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_refresh_client_statement_positions' AND position('zero lots are kept' in prosrc) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT 'fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2 has no case-insensitive spot match' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2' AND position('2026-11-12: case-insensitive' in prosrc) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT 'fn_statement_cash_inputs_v2 has no case-insensitive spot match' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_statement_cash_inputs_v2' AND position('2026-11-12: case-insensitive' in prosrc) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT 'fn_statement_cash_summary_cached_v2 has no case-insensitive spot match' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_statement_cash_summary_cached_v2' AND position('2026-11-12: case-insensitive' in prosrc) > 0) UNION ALL SELECT 'helper_var_mult_factor_view does not match spot ids case-insensitively' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_views WHERE schemaname = 'opera' AND viewname = 'helper_var_mult_factor_view' AND definition LIKE '%lower(%underlying_id%lower(%curr_mult_factor%') UNION ALL SELECT 'index idx_usv_tenant_lower_underlying_valdate is missing or invalid' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = x.indexrelid WHERE c.relname = 'idx_usv_tenant_lower_underlying_valdate' AND x.indisvalid) ) p

SELECT proname, md5(prosrc) AS src_md5, length(prosrc) AS src_length, position('client_statement_leg_rounding_table' in prosrc) > 0 AS has_leg_rounding_list, position('2026-11-12: case-insensitive' in prosrc) > 0 AS has_case_insensitive_spot FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND (proname LIKE 'fn_statement%' OR proname LIKE 'fn_refresh_client_statement%' OR proname LIKE 'fn_client_statement%') ORDER BY proname

SELECT id, dateexecuted FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id LIKE 'fn_statement_position_summaries%' OR id LIKE 'create-client-statement-leg-rounding%' OR id LIKE 'create-idx-usv%' OR id LIKE 'fn_refresh_client_statement%' ORDER BY dateexecuted DESC

SELECT i.indexname, x.indisvalid, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS index_size, s.idx_scan, s.last_idx_scan FROM pg_indexes i JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = i.indexname JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_indexes s ON s.schemaname = i.schemaname AND s.indexrelname = i.indexname WHERE i.schemaname = 'opera' AND i.tablename = 'underlying_settle_value_table' ORDER BY i.indexname

SELECT DISTINCT m.currency, m.spot AS mapping_spot, u.underlying_id AS price_spot FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(m.spot) AND u.underlying_id <> m.spot WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT p.curr_mult_factor AS product_value, u.underlying_id AS price_spot, count(*) AS products FROM opera.product_master_table p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(p.curr_mult_factor) AND u.underlying_id <> p.curr_mult_factor GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT p.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_factor, (SELECT max(u.settle_value) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.value_date = :valueDate AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(p.curr_mult_factor)) AS spot_found FROM opera.product_master_table p WHERE p.invenio_product_code = 'CM CRD'
SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, client_code, created_by, created_timestamp FROM opera.client_statement_leg_rounding_table ORDER BY tenant_id, business_unit, client_code

SELECT 'BFA is not on the leg rounding list for CFS' AS problem WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.client_statement_leg_rounding_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND upper(btrim(client_code)) = 'BFA')

SELECT relname, last_analyze, last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname = 'opera' AND relname IN ('cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'deal_ticket_table', 'option_expiry_deals_table', 'underlying_settle_value_table', 'cloned_security_info_table', 'latest_active_lot') AND coalesce(greatest(last_analyze, last_autoanalyze), timestamp '1970-01-01') < timestamp '2026-11-11 12:00:00'

SELECT value_date, count(*) AS rows_in_cache, count(DISTINCT client_code) AS clients, max(updated_timestamp) AS last_updated FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date DESC

expect.reason: functions, view and index carry the 12-Nov code (v8, case-insensitive spot ids, lower index)
mapping spot ids match the price table exactly
product curr_mult_factor matches the price table exactly
CM CRD finds its BRL spot (about 5.46)
the leg rounding list exists and is not empty
big tables were analysed after the 11-Nov type conversion
